responsibility: Implements the C++ front end’s old template repository support for -frepo. It reads and writes per-object .rpo repository files, records command-line and random-seed state needed for reproducible recompilation, tracks template-instantiation-related functions and variables with vague linkage that are available in the current translation unit, honors prelinker selections by marking chosen assembler names, and answers whether a declaration or class vtable should actually be emitted here or deferred to another object file.
